title: How B-2 Pilots Eat, Sleep & Go to the Bathroom on a 44-Hour Mission
intro: Two pilots, one closet-sized cockpit, no one to take over. In 2001 a B-2 crew flew 44.3 hours nonstop. Here's how they ate, slept and went to the bathroom.
asof_line: Figures come from the 2001 and 2025 missions as reported by Air & Space Forces Magazine and RFE/RL.
tags: b-2 spirit, stealth bomber, 44 hour mission, pilots, air refueling, piddle pack, whiteman air force base, off limits life
sources: Air & Space Forces Magazine, 15 Tons of Bombs and 1 Tiny Toilet: Around the World on the B-2 Spirit (Jun 2025): https://www.airandspaceforces.com/air-force-b-2-spirit-stealth-bomber/
RFE/RL, inside the 37-hour Midnight Hammer mission (Jun 2025): https://www.rferl.org/a/midnight-hammer-iran-strikes-b2-stealth-bomber-pilots/33454678.html
Air Force Safety Center, Fatigue management for maximum endurance flight (2025): https://www.safety.af.mil/News/Article-Display/Article/4550461/
comment: Could you stay awake for 44 hours in a closet? Where should we go next?
